# KADD Layer 2 Review — Architecture

Date: 2026-11-16 14:15:00 -05:00
Scope: Review of `canonical/kadd/2-architecture/*.yaml`

## Executive Summary

The architecture layer remains a strong and central part of the KADD collection. It connects concepts to systems, subsystems, relationships, and decision records with consistent governance language. The architecture set continues to serve as the conceptual backbone of the project.

Overall readiness: strong.

## Assessment Summary

| Dimension | Score | Notes |
| --- | ---: | --- |
| Architectural clarity | 9.1/10 | Clear decomposition and stable design frames. |
| Dependency traceability | 8.9/10 | Good progression from concept to implementation context. |
| Decision support | 8.7/10 | Decisions remain useful but can be more explicitly linked. |
| Terminology consistency | 8.6/10 | Strong, but glossary hygiene remains important. |
| Completeness | 8.8/10 | Solid overall, with incremental maturity work still worthwhile. |

## Strengths

- Strong separation of systems, subsystems, and relationships.
- Architectural decisions remain clearly defined and distinct from implementation detail.
- Effective governance model for decision-making and architectural continuity.

## Gaps

- Some technical and conceptual terminology could be aligned more tightly with current glossary updates.
- Cross-links to operational and reference entries could be more explicit in some areas.

## Recommended Actions

1. Continue terminology normalization against the glossary.
2. Ensure architecture decisions explicitly point to downstream operational consequences.
3. Keep architecture references implementation-agnostic whenever possible.

## Status

Status: Approved with minor alignment work
